sentences.text:
On The 9 th Of July, 2025
 Misc. Petition No. 2935 of 2025
 Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd
 Versus
 Smt.Suwa @ Sugunbai And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Manoj Jain - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Order

This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the order dated 11.09.2024 passed in M.A.C.C.
No.420/2023 by the learned Member, MACT, Dewas (MP), whereby the claim of respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. In a nutshell, the facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 was filed on 20.10.2023 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 19.03.2023 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No.9152/2023.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17269 2 MP-2935-2025 in MACC No.420/2023.
4.
I have heard counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd vs Smt.Suwa @ Sugunbai on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82356245/
1
